summary: Valens Semiconductor Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting that the NYSE commenced proceedings to delist its warrants (VLNW) due to abnormally low selling prices per Section 802.01D. Trading in the warrants was suspended on July 24, 2026, but the warrants remain exercisable at $11.50 per ordinary share until their expiration on September 29, 2026. The company’s ordinary shares (VLN) continue trading on NYSE. This is a regulatory delisting, not a voluntary action. Watch for any updates on warrant exercise activity or potential extension; no risk-arb angle as this is a forced delisting of an out-of-the-money warrant.
